result_is_zero retains its previous value when out != 0 (inferred latch / don't-care).
result_is_zero = 1 iff the 8-bit out == 0 (e.g., 8'hFF + 8'h01 yields out=0 and flag=1).
result_is_zero = 1 iff the full-precision sum/difference is 0 (so 8'hFF + 8'h01 yields flag=0 because carry is set).
out and result_is_zero retain previous values when do_sub is x/z (case without default).
out and result_is_zero are assigned default values (e.g., 0) for any other do_sub value.
